title: Almost Perfect
body:
1 bug and 1 problem: 
Bug is “Undo” pop-up won’t go away.
Problem is you can’t have a checklist and a passage at once; for example a list of annual instalments as a checklist and the payment code and amount as passage, or a grocery list with some notes underneath.
About time for an (actual) upgrade.
Response: Of course no change with the suggestion. Bug remains.

title: Best OCR capabilities in the market
body:
This program has the best OCR capabilities in the market. Puts to shame other like Apple Notes.

But ... has the worst ever document flow. Puts the pictures Up in a separate space and the text in an other space , rendering useless the process of “I’m writing something , put a photo under it , then some more on a topic , then a photo under it ...” so the note can’t have a nice flow.
